tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided two-layer siphon and its signed square-root branch numerically, allowing the full fallback parameter range. The existing observations vary both drive and sink gradient and are sufficient to attempt fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three parameters of the guided square-root branch; fresh confirmation can test it without another measurement.
The supplied mechanism is a before-after contrast law and does not require resolving a trajectory.
Pilot gradients are subcritical, and the monotone-concave signature supports the guided siphon branch.
